environment.description: Same application deployed on EKS 1.28 with Bottlerocket OS nodes. Pod runs with a custom seccomp profile (runtime/default augmented) and the following PodSecurityContext: runAsNonRoot=true, runAsUser=65534, readOnlyRootFilesystem=true. An emptyDir volume is mounted at /app/uploads/extracted with medium=Memory and sizeLimit=50Mi. The container's filesystem is entirely read-only except for the tmpfs-backed emptyDir at the specific extraction path. Additionally, an OPA Gatekeeper ConstraintTemplate (K8sBlockHostPath) prevents any hostPath volume mounts, and the namespace has a ResourceQuota limiting ephemeral storage to 100Mi. The pgBouncer connection uses transaction pooling mode with prepared_statement_mode=deallocate configured, and the database user has only INSERT/SELECT on file_registry table.
